title: Chapter 422 - 422 Delicious; Game!
content:
Chapter 422 - 422 Delicious; Game!

Chapter 422 - 422 Delicious; Game!

422 Delicious; Game!

Yesterday…

A few minutes ago, Nie Zhenjiang was still at a loss on the first problem.

At this moment, he had just sat down when a very clear train of thought appeared in his mind.

Then, Nie Zhenjiang picked up a pen and paper and started writing quickly.

The entire office was filled with the sound of the pen hitting the table.

In just over half an hour, pages of extremely complicated calculations were all written on the paper.

Nie Zhenjiang walked up to Lin Fan nervously and said, “Professor Lin, do you think this is the solution to this problem?”

Lin Fan quickly scanned the paper. After a few seconds, he said, “Not bad! The solution is correct.”

“Okay!” Nie Zhenjiang said excitedly.

When Jiang Chaoqun heard this, he could not help but raise his head and say, “Zhenjiang, well done! You’ve solved the Navier-Stokes equation!”

“Thank you,” Nie Zhenjiang said with a smile.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu also raised his head.

Just as he was about to say something, he sniffed and said, “What’s that smell? It feels so refreshing.”

Nie Zhenjiang said, “You should be smelling the fragrance of this tea. It’s very delicious. It’s because I drank it that I was able to answer the first problem so quickly. You guys can come and drink it too.”

Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue, who were still trying to solve the second difficult question, could not help but raise their heads and look at the tea that Nie Zhenjiang was pointing at.

After all, this involved solving a difficult problem.

Hao Zhiwu was the first to come to the coffee table. He picked up a cup of Spirit Tea and poured it into his mouth.

In the next moment, Hao Zhiwu felt as if his clothes had been torn to shreds.

It was as if he had transformed into the legendary first human—Adam!

He was naked and had a strong jumping ability. In the dense forest, he ran and jumped freely against the breeze…

It was so refreshing and pleasant!

“This tea is really delicious!” Hao Zhiwu could not help but praise.

When Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue heard this, they also walked over and poured a cup of tea into their mouths.

In the next moment, everyone’s faces revealed a touch of unconcealable comfort and enjoyment.

“So refreshing!”

“I feel much more relaxed.”

Everyone could not help but praise.

When they returned to their seats, their minds were much clearer than before.

Facing the second problem, they had some ideas.

At this moment…

They finally understood why Nie Zhenjiang had said that he could answer the first problem so quickly because he drank the tea.

This tea was simply too magical!

They were all immersed in learning.

However, sometimes, a clear mind was not enough to answer difficult questions.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was already afternoon, but no one had solved the second problem.

Yesterday and this morning, Lin Fan had been playing with the cat.

However, as time passed, it gradually became boring.

After browsing the news on his tablet for a while, he opened the group chat that he had not sent a message in for a long time.

Work Slayer: [Let’s play a few rounds of games.]

Dream Type: [Yes, the worker is a godly tycoon!

Aunty: [Coming!]

Old Rate: [I’ll be there soon!]

Meowgod: [Logging in to my account!]

…

Hao Zhiwu, who had been reading books and answering difficult problems for a long time, stood up and stretched.

He looked at his cat, Lil White, who was lying beside Lin Fan. He walked over and prepared to pet it.

He had just petted it a few times when he heard the familiar sound of Pesticide.

He looked at Lin Fan, who was holding his tablet, and said in surprise, “Professor Lin, you like to play Pesticide too?

“Haha! I like to play it too!

“I like to play mage, archer, and jungler!

“Actually, I used to like the support the most, but I often encounter some idiots who occupy the output position. The support can’t save the world at all.”

Hao Zhiwu was an extrovert.

In addition, he had been spending time with Lin Fan for the past few days and felt a sense of familiarity.

When the game was brought up, he began talking non-stop.

Hao Zhiwu said after a pause, “Actually, a large part of the reason why I chose bioengineering was that I wanted to study more about the human body!

“In the future, I want to think of a way to create a piece of equipment that allows one to enter games with their consciousness!

“Just like in Sword Art Online, where you can pick up your own weapons and kill monsters.”

As Hao Zhiwu said this, his eyes flickered.

It was as if he already had this kind of game equipment and was wantonly adventuring in the game.

At this moment…

Lin Fan, who had been playing games silently, suddenly stopped what he was doing.

This was because a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission: Watch a biology experiment and a computer experiment. Read Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, Nervous Transmission, Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns. Reward: Computer and biology experience increases by one level, gaming helmet, and its working principles.]

Hao Zhiwu saw that Lin Fan was not playing the game and that his character was about to be killed.

He was even more agitated than Lin Fan, who was the one playing games.

“Professor Lin, why aren’t you moving? Move! You’re about to be beaten to death!”

When Lin Fan heard this voice, he came back to his senses.

However, he did not play the game. Instead, he handed the tablet to Hao Zhiwu and said, “You play.”

Then, he said to the others, “Study on your own. If you encounter any questions that you don’t understand, put them aside for now. Ask me again when I come back.”

After Lin Fan finished speaking, he walked out.

Hao Zhiwu took Lin Fan’s tablet and started playing the game.

He spent a long time to avoid his character dying.

“You want to kill me? You’re still a little inexperienced!”

Hao Zhiwu could not help but nod and praise.

When he saw the IDs of his teammates, his eyes widened as he shouted, “Dream Type? Aunt? Old Rate? Meowgod?

“Oh my god!”

Dream Type, Aunt, Old Rate, and Meowgod were the most popular players in Pesticide!

In the end, these people were actually ranked together with Lin Fan!

This…

This…

Hao Zhiwu could not help but… look at Lin Fan, who had disappeared from the door.

“Professor Lin, you’re awesome!”
